title: Accept Illinois with enough cash paid out
description: Accept Illinois with enough cash paid out. Accept because red completion outweighs the moderate cash concession. The decision turns on monopoly timing and opponent threat, not printed property price.

final_action.private_thought: Accepting gives me Illinois Avenue, completing the red set, and $120 cash. I give up the utility, which is less valuable. This strengthens my position for building houses and improves cash flow.

breakdown.message: Accepts because this specific offer improves Alpha's development/liquidity window.
Private thought identifies why accepting is not just face-value chasing.
No counter-message is required for a clean accept.
